facts.fact: Le Tech Observateur refers to Law No. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on data protection as adopted and the law the CDP set out in 2017 to revise.
Le Tech Observateur says the updated data protection bill received a favourable Supreme Court opinion in 2022, with adoption by the Council of Ministers still pending in October 2024.
Le Tech Observateur reports the CDP driving the revision of the data protection law and organising the October 2024 workshop on the bill and its implementing decree.
